Native-safe WidgetShell: covers exactly the props the call sites use (title/icon/loading/error/updatedAt/isFetching/isStale/isError/onRefresh/children). Skeleton while loading (web L82), an inline danger AppText error block testID widget-error (web QueryError, L83-87, which is not yet ported), a titled header row (icon + uppercase muted caption title + freshness) or a title-less overlay freshness chip (web L120-164). showFreshness = updatedAt !== undefined; freshnessCompact = !title (web L89-91). DataFreshness is a Pressable(onRefresh) status dot+label (error>fetching>stale>fresh) whose relative time is computed once at render (no 30s interval) to avoid a dangling timer under --detectOpenHandles.

Native-safe WidgetStatGrid + StatCard: a flex-wrap grid whose flexBasis (100%/46%/22%) targets the web container-query 1/2/4 cols (web shared/WidgetStatGrid.tsx); each StatCard renders the muted label + tinted icon, a bold primary value, and a muted unit (web data-display StatCard). Empty stats -> EmptyState 'No stats available' (web L44-46).

Native AnimatedNumber reproduces the web rAF count-up exactly (Date.now elapsed, ease-out quad 1-(1-p)^2 from 0 to value over duration*1000ms, fmtNumber(display, decimals)) rendering prefix/value/suffix in a tabular-nums AppText, additionally honouring OS reduce-motion (jump to final). Icon tints map the web per-icon colours: TrendingUp/BarChart3 text-cyan-400 -> accent, Gauge text-emerald-400 -> success, Zap text-amber-400 -> warning, DollarSign text-purple-400 -> violet.

No DOM elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, framer-motion, Recharts, Leaflet, react-dom, or web UI-kit modules are imported into the native output - only React, RN primitives, the shared apps/native AppText/GlassPanel/SemanticIcon/tokens, the native parity Sparkline/EmptyState/Skeleton, and the native parity useAnalyticsSummary/useSettings hooks.
